independence.detail: Row needs participants :roles :author and :reviewer-of-record identities. Frozen live sections pin author zai-2 (author-terminal.json job.agent-id, job-id invoke-1792637169716-2135-b0c09671) and reviewer zai-3 (reviewer-terminal.json job.agent-id, job-id invoke-1792637322161-2140-9be2c424; reviewer-result.json reviewer zai-3). Distinct identities -> the row would compute :agrees, case :author-is-not-reviewer. Caveat: these are section bytes, not a run-record participants map; a later execution section must carry them into the click's decision record.

cost.detail: Per-agent token totals exist frozen (author-terminal.json usage: 851971 input / 2920 output / 854891 total, model glm-5.3), but the row requires model-usage with :complete status plus per-job phase tags and phase-timings-ms split into through-selection vs after-selection (through-selection-phases, apparatus_certificates.clj). No phase timings are recorded anywhere frozen. Requires a later execution section.

precision.detail: Row reads decision [:selection-certificate :policy-precision-state]. The frozen cascade fixture's selection-certificate (00-selected.edn.gz) contains no :policy-precision-state at all; the beta-prior 1.0 and habit prior masses (0.951229...) found in the fixture are selection-time inputs, not the precision-state record. Also even with the record present, the row currently returns absent unless :update retains prior and posterior DISTRIBUTIONS (code returns :policy-distributions-not-retained when only beta numbers are there).

class_preference.detail: Row needs scored :class-emission candidates under :selection-certificate :scoring. Frozen fixture's only :scoring entry is {:scorer-version nil, :g-terms nil} at :pre-selector-binding — no class-emission candidate, so the row verdict would be :not-recorded (:no-scored-class-emission-candidate). This is ABSENCE, not a violated equation: no recorded risk was checked and none failed.

strategic_focus.detail: Row needs :focus-receipt on the decision plus consumed target-classes in scored observation models. Fixture has no :focus-receipt. Consistent with lean-alignment-reconciled.md: focus does not yet set class preference; the fixed terminal preference (apparatus_certificates.clj terminal-preference 55/35/5/5) remains, so even a future record cannot reach :agrees until the focus->preference hop lands (Claude2's carry work, not duplicated here).

rows.evidence: typed-absence-in-source: constant-row [:likelihood] at receipt; nothing frozen or live supplies it.
rows.habit: typed-absence-in-source: constant-row [:counts-after :next-consumed]. The fixture's habit-prior masses and :habit fields are policy-selection metadata (e.g. :habit 1 in M-formal-war-machine census), not habit counts-after; do not conflate them with the R20 habit row.
rows.interoception: typed-absence-in-source AND in Lean: hard-coded absent (:no-interoceptive-modality-recorded) at d089214d5; G lacks the interoceptive risk term (r20-lean-edges.edn edge :interoceptionToSelectionG has empty source-sites and no carriers). No equation is violated — the modality simply is not recorded anywhere.

ports_and_run_identity.frozen_cascade_fixture: The frozen selected cascade is a single futon-theory/mission-lifecycle box (M-pattern-posteriors/policy-2f5c7f6d3345d326aae3, cascade-digest 9c2f7532552a2c940429c7f2b16e74a3df2f2c5463927b3051089a8d30929387). Stage digests chain per verification.edn; wiring-status :wired, task-executed false, completion-status :unchecked. A grep across all six frozen stages finds no :run-id, no :policy-precision-state, no :focus-receipt, no :model-usage, no :participants. So Wired-with-current-run-identity on R20 ports cannot be evaluated from this fixture at all — absence, not a failed check.
ports_and_run_identity.r20_edges: The eight Lean edges (R20Witness.lean allEdges; exported in r20-lean-edges.edn) name their port sites in futon2 source (enactment_habit, policy, policy_precision_carry#advance, focus_receipt, cascade_shape_g#class-emission-model, apparatus_certificates#class-preference-row). Of these only the habit->selection source (enactment_habit fold/masses) and selection sites are exercised by the frozen selection; the precision-carry, focus-receipt and class-emission sites need a later executed click.

old_vs_current_distinctions: The r20-lean-edges.edn pins mathlib4 719e4a3e9c (Claude7 one-click pin) — a valid static graph pin, but not the combined R20 definitions pin 862666e9; per lean-alignment-reconciled.md regenerate via lake build + r20-lean-edges.sh only when assessing a repaired deployed revision.

Treating fixture fields as current producer output would be old-fixture-as-current-source.

single_smallest_useful_recording_repair.choice: Retain the prior and posterior policy distributions (with the beta prior/posterior and solve terms) inside :selection-certificate :policy-precision-state :update at the existing write site futon2/src/futon2/aif/policy_precision_carry.clj#advance, during the next executed project click.
single_smallest_useful_recording_repair.why_smallest: One existing write site, no new producer, no schema change beyond retaining fields the row already knows how to read (precision-row, apparatus_certificates.clj). It converts the precision row from :policy-distributions-not-retained to a real agrees/disagrees verdict on the first executed click, exercises the selectionToPrecisionHabit/selectionToPrecisionG/inferenceToPrecisionF edge sites, and — unlike the focus->preference hop (Claude2's carry work) or the interoception modality (needs a G term in Lean first) — it is unblocked.
single_smallest_useful_recording_repair.tied_to_useful_execution: Run it on the next of the ten allocated project clicks (0 of 10 issued per allocation.json), with run identity stamped on the ports, then inventory the ten rows present/conforming/absent per lean-alignment-reconciled.md's 'Next live report'.
single_smallest_useful_recording_repair.runner_up: Record phase-timings-ms and per-job phase-tagged model usage in the click's run record (unlocks the cost row's through/after split); deferred because it is a second recording site and the precision repair also unblocks three Lean edge sites at once.
